title: Hall of Arms (disambiguation)
wikitext:
A '''Hall of Arms''' is a building or room typically associated with martial and military pursuits. The following are the locations across [[Azeroth]] that are known as a ''Hall of Arms'':

*[[Hall of Arms (Northshire)|Hall of Arms, Northshire Abbey]]; part of the famed [[Northshire Abbey]] in [[Kingdom of Stormwind|Stormwind]]'s [[Elwynn Forest]]. 
*[[Hall of Arms|Hall of Arms, Ironforge]]; headquarters of [[Ironforge (faction)|Ironforge]]'s armed forces, located in the [[Military Ward]]. 
*[[Hall of Arms (Tyr's Hand)|Hall of Arms, Tyr's Hand Abbey]]; belonging to the [[Scarlet Crusade]] as part of [[Tyr's Hand]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]].
